description: A watch link to a person's own machine desk (plan L55): the owner's agent (OpenVibe.Actor) asks Bot for a link that shows the desk it works on (the private desk or its own desk-<name>, never the owner's own screen), live, inside a chat turn. POST /api/v1/machines/:id/watch-links (bot.watch-link-request@1, answered by bot.watch-link-result@1) makes one for the machine the named person owns — never another person's (404) — and it lives for 5 to 240 minutes. The page needs no sign-in (the token is the credential), may sit in a frame on openvibe.chat or openvibe.actor, and carries the mouse and keyboard only when the caller asks for it. Only the owner's agent may make one: the capability alone would let any service that holds it name any person.
